extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: MCP broker into your live Neovim/diver config: LSP, formatters, linters, DAP, MATE attention. Periscope brokers to a real Neovim running the actual diver config (managed or attach mode), so clients query the same language servers, formatter registry, linter registry, and DAP module tree the editor uses — one configuration source of truth. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Periscope does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Periscope

skills.description: Broker status and read-only intelligence from the live Neovim/diver session: diagnostics with the producing source named on every entry, hover, definition, references, document symbols, and configured/attached LSP servers (broker_status, get_diagnostics, get_hover, get_definition, get_references, get_document_symbols, list_servers).
skills.name: Editor LSP intelligence

skills.description: The live config's own registries, read in place: formatter modules, linter modules, and the DAP module tree with adapters and configurations registered in the session (list_formatters, list_linters, list_dap).
skills.name: Config registries

skills.description: Run the config's formatter and linter pipelines inside the brokered editor; formatting is applied to the buffer and returned as text — the file on disk is never written (run_format, run_lint).
skills.name: Editor pipelines

skills.description: A joint-attention coordination board held in the server process: publish an ordered focus bound to your client identity, read a partner agent's focus, and ask for an alignment score or a coordination decision (attention_publish, attention_focus, attention_alignment, attention_decide).
skills.name: Joint attention (MATE)
